threshold_note: threshold is rolling (window per lookback); threshold_value is the latest rolling value — see winner_trade_log.csv for the full threshold path
strategy_description: Long SPY when the lagged BUSLOANS signal is above its threshold; otherwise cash. (Countercyclical orientation: low/decelerating loan growth = risk-on.)
lead_description: Signal lead = 6 month(s); L1 is the real-time floor given the ~2-3 week H.8 publication lag
notes: Mode 1, fix260612_busloans_spy. Tournament: 6100 strategy combos (+1 benchmark, valid=False per ECON-T4), 4396 valid. Winner by ECON-T3 cascade (resolved at step 1; 1 tied at step 1). Strategy returns are gross of transaction costs; 5 bps sensitivity in tournament_validation_20260612/. BUSLOANS is a LAGGING indicator (Conference Board lagging-index component); Toda-Yamamoto Granger finds NO forward causality (BUSLOANS->SPY n.s. at all lags 1-12) and STRONG reverse causality (SPY->BUSLOANS significant at every lag) — this pair is primarily confirmatory, and the strategy edge should be read with corresponding caution. Robustness caveats: winner bootstrap p = 0.066 (NOT significant at 5% vs resampled B&H); in-sample Sharpe 0.35 vs OOS 1.50 (IS/OOS inconsistency suggests a favorable OOS draw); CP1 durability verdict 'episode_concentrated'; rolling-correlation stability 'sign_unstable'. OOS exposure is sparse (mean position 0.25) — most of the DD advantage comes from being in cash.
